description: Specs, cited sources, price snapshots, and a transparent 0-5 BestRobotMower Score for wire-free and RTK robot lawn mowers. Compiled and computed by BestRobotMower.co, an independent comparison site.

score_methodology.note: Weighted average of the per-axis sub-scores; weights renormalise over the axes present. Only shipping models are scored. Full rubric: https://bestrobotmower.co/methodology

price_disclaimer: Price fields are DATED SNAPSHOTS of the cheapest tracked retail price at prices_last_verified, not live prices. See the source_url on the site for the current price.
